speaker: richard_burbage
text: You heard me. Off is off. The end is a short road, and this door is not a window.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am standing, which is not the same as looking. The paint is still on. The stitch is still in. That remains the news.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The yard is still in. George is at the outer door with me. We are not letting them yet. When we do, you will hear the hinges, and not a speech from me before them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hinges will do. I have no question to send out to that door. If there is a word for after, it can be after.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am empty. I said I would be. I am not going to invent a line to prove I was in the play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then be empty. John, take George back to the hinges. This room has finished being useful, and it knows it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will stand until the hinges. I am not making the wait into anything else.
